description: Compact, product-aware report for a completed scan. Pass AT MOST ONE of runId, projectId, or domain. runId reads that run's report. domain reads the latest completed report for the project covering that domain (any subdomain matches). No identifier reads the organization's most recent completed run. With domain or no identifier, product narrows resolution to that product's latest run. projectId keeps the 1.0 contract: product marketing_signal serves the project marketing report, otherwise the newest completed AI-Readiness run. Every response carries a resolved block (runId, projectId, domain, how) naming the run that was read. Discriminate on the product field: AI-Readiness serves score, severity mix, and foundation files; Marketing Signal serves score, the five stage scores (find, trust, act, measure, improve), and source coverage. Best for: the FIRST read after a scan completes, before paging findings. Not for: per-finding detail (index365_get_finding) or starting scans (index365_start_scan). Common mistake: passing two identifiers at once; pass one or none. Example: index365_get_report({ domain: 'yoursite.com' }). Next: index365_list_findings for the prioritized list.

domain.description: Domain or URL resolved to its project's latest completed run (www. is ignored; any subdomain of a project's domain matches). Alternative to runId/projectId. Omit all three for the organization's most recent completed run.

product.description: With projectId: which product's latest report (default ai_readiness). With domain or no identifier: narrows resolution to that product's latest completed run (default: any product).

projectId.description: Project id for the latest completed report (1.0 contract, default ai_readiness)

runId.description: Run id for one run's report (pass at most one of runId/projectId/domain)

name: index365_get_report
title: Get the compact report
